senses.gloss: m. (בקע; cmp. בִּצְעָה) fissure, ditch, esp. small pond for washing clothes.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 8b:5">M. Kat. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>נברכת וב׳</he>, expl. as <he>גיהא ובר גיהא</he> a large pond and a small pond.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 1:2">Tosef. B. Bath. I, 2</cite>.

M. Kat. I, 9 זו היא נ׳ … ב׳ Nibrekheth a. B’kia are the same; Y. ib. I, 80ᵈ כל שהוא תושב וכ׳ any permanent cut in the ground is called בקיע (fissure, a grave, wash-pond &c.). [Another opin. in Ar. ב׳ = אבן ב׳ a flat stone whereon washers beat their clothes; Y. l. c. כל שהוא וכ׳ any stone fixed in the ground is called a b’kia.—Ms. M. a. ed. Ven. נְקִיעַ, v. נֶקַע.]
